scope: Fixed synthetic software validation only; not external data validation, biological replication, or evidence that scientific conclusions are correct.
limitations: SciPy Dunnett uses randomized integration; the declared absolute tolerance is 0.0005 and five fixed seeds are reported.
The Dunnett cases have moderate p values and do not independently validate extreme-tail accuracy.
This validates current hashed working-tree sources, not an unmodified release commit.
It does not validate GUI behavior, real instrument files, or correctness of user-declared experimental independence.

_public_export.scope: Selected original summary/identity fields only. This export does not rerun tests and does not certify later integrated PR commits.
